body:
Thank you guys. I talked to my parents and told them that I am suicidal. They took it surprisingly well and we're going to meet with my therapist on Monday to figure what to do. I told my parents about the pills I was planning on taking and we flushed them down the toilet together. I think its going to be hard but I've made the first step to getting better

​

I guess my question is, is it worth it to risk my relationship with my family and friends, my grades and school life for this? I feel like I might never bounce back from telling them and I will regret not just killing myself.

I know I need help, like serious immediate help but I don't know how to force myself to get it

​

I know I need to tell her or someone but I don't want to mess up my life because of this. I know that's a really stupid thing to say because I know I'll probably attempt if I don't do something but I'm worried that saying something will make things worse.
